correctness.rationale: The seven irreducible linear factors must be permuted by every projective automorphism. Exactly five triple points and two distinguished collinear triple sets force fixation of P0, preservation of x-y, and preservation or exchange of x=0 and y=0. The four remaining points rule out the exchange case and leave only I and tau in the preserve case. Exact rational frame enumeration and Gaussian coefficient checks corroborate all steps. Tau preserves Q and Qbar separately, but these differ at xy and agree at z^2, proving no conjugate equivalence. Definability over R would imply such equivalence, and coefficient field Q(i) then gives precisely Q(i) as the absolute field of moduli. No step depends on sampling infinitely many maps.

value.rationale: The source's concrete nonreal near-free arrangement is central to an explicit open question about a *real* Numerical Terao counterexample. The obstruction demonstrates that this highly natural first candidate cannot be salvaged by projective coordinate change, and its explicit complete stabilizer yields the crucial rigidity certificate. The older paper already has real free arrangements, so the obstruction concerns the genuinely missing nearly-free side. It does not claim the open real existence problem is solved.
